contest.measure_text: Term Limits Reform Measure Shall the terms served by the City Council in the City of South El Monte be limited to no more than four (4) four-year terms in their lifetime and where service for the unexpired balance of a vacated City Council seat (whether by appointment or election) will not count as service for a full four-year term even if such service is for less than four years in duration? Supporters: Gloria Olmos, Mayor; Rudy Bojorquez, Councilmember; Hector Delgado, Councilmember; Larry Rodriguez, Councilmember; Manuel Acosta, Councilmember Opponents: None submitted.
contest.office: CITY OF SOUTH EL MONTE SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION - MEASURE CL
